people.name: Barnabas
people.line: A Levite from Cyprus who accompanied Paul on missionary journeys.

people.name: Cyprus
people.line: Island in the Mediterranean Sea; early Christian community

people.name: Mark
people.line: Cousin of Barnabas, companion of Paul, author of Gospel.

translations.web: Then the contention grew so sharp that they separated from each other. Barnabas took Mark with him and sailed away to Cyprus,
translations.bsb: Their disagreement was so sharp that they parted company. Barnabas took Mark and sailed for Cyprus,
translations.kjv: And the contention was so sharp between them, that they departed asunder one from the other: and so Barnabas took Mark, and sailed unto Cyprus;
translations.asv: And there arose a sharp contention, so that they parted asunder one from the other, and Barnabas took Mark with him, and sailed away unto Cyprus;
